identification.reported_issue: load_session unpickles the session cookie sent by the browser. A crafted cookie could make the server import and call arbitrary functions. Analyze this component only.

source.quote:
def load_session(cookie: str) -> dict:
    return pickle.loads(base64.b64decode(cookie))
